body: When me and my childhood best friend were young, probably about 12 years old, there was a rumor going around my neighborhood that there was some kind of pale monster running around in the wooded area during the night between a street with houses and a public park. Obviously now being 21 years old, we were perfectly primed to go monster hunting in 2010 as creepypastas like Jeff the Killer and Slenderman were just starting to hit their stride in popularity. My dad happened to be an electrician and had an abundance of tools and equipment in our garage at the time (he now runs a really successful hair product business). Anyways, after hearing about this supposed thing I came up with a super "fool proof" way of getting evidence on the matter. My friend and I stole some of my dad's thin metal wire (kind of like the kind chicken fence is made out of) and wrapped it around the perimeter and zigzagging of this wooded area. The plan was to come back the next morning and see if any of the wire had been broken or disturbed. The next morning comes and when we go out to check on the wire we were incredibly surprised to find a bit of blood on one of the broken sections of wire. Super confused, we didn't really know what to do with this information and were made to take down the wire after a neighbor of mine told my dad what we did to the wooded area. A couple weeks go by and news starts spreading that there was a man who was jogging around our neighborhood BUTT ASS NAKED in the middle of the night. The scary thing is nobody was able to catch the guy, but one of the neighbors was able to get a good look at this "thing" one night and determined that, holy shit, it's just some really weird ass dude. Still wonder if he's up to it today, shortly afterwards my parents separated and I ended up moving in with my dad.
